name: Kibroth-hattaavah
brief: A place where the Israelites complained and were punished
short: Kibroth-hattaavah, meaning "graves of craving," was a place where the Israelites complained about the lack of meat and were punished with a plague (<ref="Numbers 11:34-35; 33:16-17; Deu.9.22">Numbers 11:34-35; 33:16-17; Deu.9.22</ref>).
